# Level 3 — Mid-Level Java Backend Engineer

**Audience:** Working junior engineers or Level 2 graduates.

**Graduation outcome:** Designs and owns moderately complex services, troubleshoots production issues, reasons about performance and reliability, and makes informed technical trade-offs.

| Structured study | Recorded video | Lessons |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 300–450 h | 60–85 h | 180–250 |

## Capstone — Distributed Order Processing Platform (`MID-CAP`)

Independently deployable services split along domain boundaries: order saga, transactional outbox, idempotent consumers, inventory reservation, Redis caching, tracing, DLQs, load tests, recovery runbooks.

**Graduation gate:** Diagnoses a simulated production incident, improves a measured performance bottleneck, and defends the architecture's trade-offs.

See [`projects/ladder.md`](../../projects/ladder.md) for the full brief and [`assessment/framework.md`](../../assessment/framework.md) for grading.
